verdict.rationale: Kick documents native multi-entity management: all entities live in a single workspace, each with its own books, reports and transaction history. Shared expenses can be split across entities, and the Plus plan allows unlimited entities. However, nothing in the evidence shows consolidated financial statements across entities, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: consolidated P&L/Balance Sheet across entities, intercompany eliminations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them

citations.quote: If you own more than one business, or have a holding company structure, Kick lets you manage all your entities from a single workspace.
Each entity has its own books, reports, and transaction history.
you can split a single transaction across multiple entities by amount or percentage.
Plus — $100/mo — Unlimited entities, classes, accrual ledger, AR & AP
